meta.name: social-media-scheduler
meta.description: Create a 30-day social media content calendar for affiliate marketing. Triggers on: "create a social media calendar", "30-day content plan", "social media schedule", "content calendar for [product]", "plan my social posts", "social media strategy", "schedule my affiliate posts", "content plan for LinkedIn", "30 days of content", "social posting schedule", "what should I post this month", "write my social content", "create posts for LinkedIn X Facebook", "affiliate content calendar", "social media plan for my affiliate program".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成30天社交媒体内容日历
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速规划联盟营销的社交媒体内容
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate a 30-day social media content calendar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly plan social media content for your affiliate program

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会生成一个30天的社交媒体内容日历，包含帖子文案、标签和推荐发布时间，并遵循80%价值/互动、20%推广的规则。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建社交媒体日历、30天内容计划或为特定产品制定发布计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个30天的LinkedIn内容日历，推广我的新产品。
say.note: Claude会生成包含帖子文案和发布计划的日历。

say.text: 我想为我的联盟营销计划制定社交媒体发布 schedule。
为我的SEO工具写一份30天的社交帖子计划。
say.note: Claude会输出适合各平台的帖子。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a 30-day social media content calendar with post copy, hashtags, and recommended scheduling times, following the 80/20 rule (80% value/engagement, 20% promotional).
howto.when_en: The skill triggers when you ask for a social media calendar, a 30-day content plan, or a posting schedule for a specific product.

say_en.text: Create a 30-day LinkedIn content calendar for promoting my new product.
say_en.note: Claude will output a calendar with post copy and scheduling.

say_en.text: I need a social media schedule for my affiliate marketing program.
say_en.note: Claude will plan content following the 80/20 rule.

say_en.text: Write a 30-day social posting plan for my SEO tool.
